headline: Shoriful takes 6-35 as Bangladesh keep hopes alive in Australia
summary: After being bowled out for 64, a stunning six-wicket haul from Shoriful Islam has put the Tigers back in the contest during the second Test.
details: Pacer Shoriful Islam produced the performance of his Test career, claiming a maiden five-wicket haul to finish with figures of 6-35.
His spell included the key wickets of Travis Head, Marnus Labuschagne, Steven Smith, Beau Webster, Pat Cummins, and Mitchell Starc.
The effort restricted Australia to 165 for eight, leaving them with a 101-run lead after Bangladesh had been bowled out for just 64 in their first innings.
Shoriful, returning from a hamstring injury, struck twice in his very first over to shift the momentum of the match.
Despite the personal milestone, Shoriful emphasized that the team's goal is to win the match and bounce back strongly in the next innings.
The match saw a battle of swing bowling, with Australia's Mitchell Starc also claiming 6-12 during Bangladesh's collapse.
caption:
From 64 all out to a fighting comeback! Shoriful Islam's career-best 6-35 keeps Bangladesh in the game.

Pacer Shoriful Islam produced the performance of his Test career, claiming a maiden five-wicket haul to finish with figures of 6-35.

His spell included the key wickets of Travis Head, Marnus Labuschagne, Steven Smith, Beau Webster, Pat Cummins, and Mitchell Starc.

The effort restricted Australia to 165 for eight, leaving them with a 101-run lead after Bangladesh had been bowled out for just 64 in their first innings.

Shoriful, returning from a hamstring injury, struck twice in his very first over to shift the momentum of the match.

Despite the personal milestone, Shoriful emphasized that the team's goal is to win the match and bounce back strongly in the next innings.

The match saw a battle of swing bowling, with Australia's Mitchell Starc also claiming 6-12 during Bangladesh's collapse.
